HigherUp.ai logo

One mark, two meanings: companies hire up, and students and job seekers level up their skills. The design uses only the colours already on the website.

The idea

  1. An "H" that climbs. Read quickly, it is the H of HigherUp.
  2. The short left stem is the candidate starting out: a student, a graduate, a career switcher.
  3. The taller right stem ends in an arrow: growth, and the company hiring up.
  4. The rising crossbar in soft periwinkle is the step between them: proof of skills that connects people to opportunities.

Primary logo

On light backgrounds (website, documents)

On dark backgrounds (slides, dark cards)

Mark on its own

For app icons, the browser tab, social profiles and slide corners.

Small sizes

Wordmark

higherup.ai

Plus Jakarta Sans, ExtraBold, tight letter spacing. Always lowercase. "up" in indigo; ".ai" in soft grey so the name reads first.
